## Summary

Describe the report, dataset, SQL, documentation, or maintenance change.

## Scope
- [ ] Power BI report/model
- [ ] Source data / transformations
- [ ] SQL/schema/import
- [ ] PDF export
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository automation/governance

## Validation
- [ ] Source data lineage and version are recorded.
- [ ] Row counts and field types were checked where applicable.
- [ ] Key calculations were reconciled independently.
- [ ] PBIX opens and refreshes successfully (for report changes).
- [ ] Slicers, filters, and affected visuals were tested.
- [ ] PDF export matches the saved report (where applicable).
- [ ] SQL was tested safely in a disposable environment.
- [ ] Data/asset licensing and confidentiality were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials or private data are included.

## Evidence
Attach sanitized screenshots, refresh errors, sample summaries, or before/after exports.

## Known limitations
List anything not verified.
